inputs.statement: INVENTED inputs, for a format sample only: this file shows the results layout. No value in it is a reference value of any registered case.

per_mode_layout: theta_k[k][j] and one_minus_theta_k[k][j]: mode k in the block's declared order (from 0), voltage j

method.route_A: The closed forms of spec/LAWS.md sections 2-6 in Python's decimal arithmetic (libmpdec), rounding half-even: B(x) = x/(e^x - 1) with e^x - 1 at raised precision; each 1 - theta_k = K_k/(c_B + K_k) formed directly and u = sum_k w_k (1 - theta_k) / sum_k w_k, left to right in mode order; the slopes by the analytic forms of sections 2, 4 and 5. The reported values are route A's.
method.E_ion: The Nernst potential at 120 digits, rounded half-even to 50 significant digits. This 50-digit value is E_ion throughout: in the voltage list and in V_ref = V - E_ion, so V_ref is exactly 0 at V = E_ion. Route B recomputes it with its own ln and rounds it by integer arithmetic; the two agree exactly.
method.route_B: Exact rational arithmetic (fractions.Fraction) with the package's own binary exp and ln, intermediate results rounded to 640 significant bits; no decimal module. The GHK flux in its classical form 1e15 A P r a o v x (c_i - c_o e^-x)/(1 - e^-x), with its own x = 0 limit; K_k = exp(ln K_k(0) + a_k V_ref); theta_k = 1/(1 + K_k/c_B), 1 - theta_k = 1/(1 + c_B/K_k); u by the literal 1 - sum_k w_k theta_k / sum_k w_k; every slope by a central difference of route B's own values, step 1e-50 V, or 1e-50 times the concentration, with E recomputed unrounded from a perturbed concentration under the reversal reference.
method.difference_measure: |A - B| / max(|A|, |B|), in exact rational arithmetic. A quantity that is exactly 0 in both routes counts 0 (the free flux and current at V = 0 when c_i = c_o; theta_k when c_B = 0). route_difference uses route A's 120-digit working values; reported_strings_against_route_B uses the 30-digit strings in this file.
